type: MVEI kernel certificate for a branch

history_not_on_default_branch.subject: Improve documentation: clarify Lean4 skeleton is a specification
Add Riemann Hypothesis refutation framework: LaTeX, Lean4, and README

verification.checker: Lean 4 kernel; axioms read with Lean.collectAxioms (#print axioms)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Framework_Depends_On_Law4
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ), (∀ ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros, ρ.re ∈ GlobalMinima T) → GlobalMinima T ≠ {1 / 2} → ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: LocalPotential_nonneg
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T σ t : ℝ), 0 ≤ LocalPotential T σ t

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MostPlausibleRefutation
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ),   (∃ σ₀, 0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 1 ∧ σ₀ ≠ 1 / 2 ∧ EnergyFunctional T σ₀ < EnergyFunctional T (1 / 2)) →     (∀ ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros, EnergyFunctional T ρ.re = MinEnergy T) → ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RF1_MinimumOffCriticalLine
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ),   (∀ (σ : ℝ), 0 < σ → σ < 1 → EnergyFunctional T σ = EnergyFunctional T (1 - σ)) →     (∃ σ₀, 0 < σ₀ ∧ σ₀ < 1 ∧ σ₀ ≠ 1 / 2 ∧ EnergyFunctional T σ₀ ≤ EnergyFunctional T (1 / 2)) →       (∀ ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros, ρ.re ∈ GlobalMinima T) → ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RF2_NonPositiveCurvature
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T : ℝ),   (∀ (σ t : ℝ),       0 < σ →         σ < 1 → deriv (fun σ' => LocalPotential T σ' t) σ = 0 → deriv (deriv fun σ' => LocalPotential T σ' t) σ ≠ 0) →     deriv (deriv (EnergyFunctional T)) (1 / 2) ≤ 0 →       (∀ ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros, deriv (deriv (EnergyFunctional T)) ρ.re > 0) → ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: RF3_MultipleMinimalGeodesics
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T P : ℝ),   P > 0 →     (∃ γ₁, (∀ (t : ℝ), (γ₁ t).1 ≠ 1 / 2) ∧ GeodesicEnergy T γ₁ P ≤ GeodesicEnergy T CriticalGeodesic P) →       (∀ ρ ∈ NonTrivialZeros, ∃ γ, GeodesicEnergy T γ P = sInf {x | ∃ γ', GeodesicEnergy T γ' P = x} ∧ ρ.re = (γ 0).1) →         ¬RiemannHypothesis

theorems_only_on_branches.name: weight_symmetric
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: ∀ (T t : ℝ), weight T t = weight T (-t)
